newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot working to comply on pricing.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot working to comply on pricing.

text.p: Home Depot Inc, an Atlanta-based retailer, responded to Michigan Attorney General's office Monday that it was working to comply with the state of Michigan's item pricing requirements.

In a statement, Home Depot said, "The company noted Massachusetts and Michigan are the only states where Home Depot does business using unit pricing, and further notes that all of its stores have merchandise clearly and conspicuously marked by shelving pricing and UPC (Universal Pricing Code) bar codes.

"The Home Depot abides by the Michigan law and will quickly put in place the additional pricing information. The company is meeting with the attorney general's office to assure continuing compliance," it concluded.
Earlier Monday, the Michigan Attorney General said his office filed a Notice of Intended Action charging Home Depot with violating the state's item pricing and deceptive advertising acts.
